{{Quote|What does this device do, and how does it do it?|Montacca|<ref name="RM" />}}
'''Montacca''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] ex-[[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] with an out-of-the-ordinary fascination with technology of all sorts, going so far as to touch the technology of near-strangers out of intense curiosity. He was a free Wookiee during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and a passenger on the [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] when that ship was [[Attack on the Kuari Princess|struck]] by the [[Riders of the Maelstrom]].
